83333.company: Sun Valley Refuse (BCRD franchise hauler for Hailey area)
83333.bottle: Recycle empty plastic bottles and glass bottles in the commingled recycling cart/bin (rinse/empty; leave caps on plastic when possible).
83333.cup: Generally DO NOT recycle disposable cups. Paper coffee cups are not accepted (plastic lining). Most plastic cups are not accepted unless they are a rigid bottle/jug; put in trash unless specifically labeled and locally accepted.
83333.wine glass: Do NOT recycle. Drinkware/tempered glass is not accepted in curbside recycling; dispose in trash (or donate if usable).
83333.vase: Do NOT recycle in curbside. Put in trash or donate if usable; only container glass bottles/jars are accepted.
83333.default: Hailey-area residential recycling is commingled (single-stream) and typically accepts clean paper/cardboard, metal cans, and container plastics and glass bottles/jars. Keep items empty/clean/dry, place loose (not bagged), and exclude plastic bags/film, food-soiled paper, Styrofoam, electronics, and non-container glass (windows, mirrors, Pyrex, ceramics, drinking glasses, vases).
